name: Jones: Jomblo is Happiness
source:
This is your first day at high school...

You never had a girlfriend and all of your friends said you'll going to be Forever Alone (Jones). But no, it's time to prove to all that you can graduate from high school and be happy...even if you're single!

Live out your days and face the challenging high school life by balancing your financial, social life, academic, health, and possibly romance. You must keep your spirit up and may be you will get a girlfriend!

[Taken from Google Play page]
translation:
這是你高中第一天……

你從未有過女朋友，朋友都說你會永遠孤獨。但不，現在是時候向所有人證明，即使單身，你也能順利畢業並獲得幸福……

在校園生活中度過每一天，平衡財務、社交、學業、健康，以及可能出現的戀愛。你必須保持精神狀態，也許最終會交到女朋友！

[取自Google Play頁面]
